input.quote: the validity, interpretation and legal effect of this Agreement shall be governed by the internal laws of the State of New York, U.S.A., applicable to contracts entered in and performed entirely within the State of New York, U.S.A. without regard to any conflict of law principles.
input.rationale: Governing law is New York internal law, and venue is exclusive: suits must be instituted in the City of New York with irrevocable submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the S.D.N.Y. or the New York state courts, plus a waiver of venue/forum non conveniens objections. No arbitration provision appears anywhere in the document (search for "arbitration" returns nothing), so there is no offshore arbitration seat. This matches the preferred position (New York law, exclusive New York courts). The clause says "City of New York" rather than "New York County" — a de minimis wording difference that captures the same forum and is not a deviation. Reciprocal in application to both parties, so no direction concern.
